summary: Slice S4c (PRD_VIEWER_UX 4.7-4.9). New pure src/projects/node/panels.ts (reviewer time/deadline, blocking findings, challenge headline, handoff wait from receipts, approval line, integrated commit, section entries) with tests/unit/panels.test.ts (7 tests). NodeDetail now holds the review resource (ReviewDetail's former key and fallback; also loaded for the approval's bundle), builds the review/challenge index entries, renders the challenge headline and passes node, events, spans, inputs and review to the controller sections; ReviewPanel no longer fetches. Review: blocking cards (blocking-finding, outside review-findings) before the table, reviewer-time beside reviewer-status (took / launch time not recorded (print) / no verdict · launched), findings table restyled as cards at <=760px. Challenge: one headline, record folded, P0/P1 open, P2 one line each. Controller: handoff-summary with wait from receipts, approval-summary with ≈ and 'no approval event recorded' plus bundle, integrate-summary with branch, commit and 'no push performed', awaiting-since on AwaitingNotice. Fixtures in fixtures/ux-review.ts for both phases (parity with the real RunStore checked by a throwaway script), spec ux-review.spec.ts with the three scenarios. Red first: unit 7/7 failed on a skeleton; browser 3/3 failed in both phases (soft-copy list in docs/handoff/ux-s4c.md). Green, executed: npm run build ok; npm run lint clean; npx tsx --test tests/unit/panels.test.ts 7 passed; npm run test:unit 278 passed; playwright worker and candidate: ux-review review reviewers guardrails projects ux-node ux-run clarity lanes inputs 45 passed each, ux-verify ux-launch ux-time 9 passed each; JSON report of ux-review.spec.ts in both phases passed workflow check-report. No commits.
open_assumptions: Per-reviewer live elapsed time and deadline are not rendered (decisions.md deferral); reviewerDeadline/deadlineText exist and are unit-tested only.
The blocking card links the requirement in the lane's task, not a file location (the review records none); no [More] on P2 table rows.
Review index lists Blocking N (only when N>0) and Findings N; no Diff entry (S7). Challenge index lists Concerns N and Alternative & experiment.
An automatic run's approval without an event is worded 'approved automatically by the finish policy (<finish>)', a manual one 'approved by the operator'; its instant is triage's (≈ the integration).
awaiting-since is shown only when the waiting node has a status row; the manual approval command comes from deriveNow in node-next.
Challenge styles are in node/review.css since no challenge stylesheet is in the lane's owned paths.
